memories.content: The mayor is aware of this morning's third water-main burst and the public concern it is generating. They have not yet decided whether to issue a public statement. They consider the political and operational implications of speaking out or staying silent.

Riverton has experienced three water-main bursts this morning (2026-08-12). The third burst occurred earlier today. The mayor's office is the usual channel for official public statements. The public and local media are paying attention.
